description: This file contains shell functions related to handling git bundle files, including converting bundle data to pack format and testing the object count within a bundle.

methods.name: convert_bundle_to_pack
methods.description: Reads bundle data, skipping header, and outputs the pack data.

methods.name: test_bundle_object_count
methods.description: Checks the number of objects in a bundle file, optionally fixing a thin pack, and verifies against expected count.
